summary: Round r1 (restricted network): primary documents located for capital budget vs actual (MoF Red Books FY2079/80, FY2082/83, FY2083/84; Economic Surveys 2023/24 English, 2081/82 and 2082/83 Nepali; FCGO Consolidated Financial Statements and monthly expenditure reports; NRB monthly Current Macroeconomic and Financial Situation), for within-year timing (FCGO monthly reports, NRB monthly releases), for execution diagnostics (World Bank Capital Expenditure Bottlenecks Analysis October 2025, Nepal Development Updates November 2025 and April 2026, Public Expenditure Review; IMF 2026 Article IV with PIMA action plan; PEFA 2024 national and Gandaki 2025) and for audit findings (OAG annual reports incl. 62nd report on FY2080/81, English summaries of 52nd, 55th, 58th; PPMO annual reports and OCDS data). No file could be downloaded and snippet figures were not used, so every quantitative item is pending. Key design points: execution rates must be computed against both original and mid-term-revised capital budgets; federal and consolidated three-tier capex must be separated; NRB (cash basis) and FCGO series are kept as separate observations.

findings.claim: Q1: Federal capital expenditure, original appropriation vs revised (mid-term review) estimate vs actual, by fiscal year
findings.note: Red Book original capital appropriation; MoF mid-term review revised estimate; FCGO CFS / Economic Survey actual. Execution rate computed against BOTH original and revised denominators.

findings.claim: Q1: Capital budget execution rate (actual / original appropriation and actual / revised estimate), federal
findings.note: Derived from the above; World Bank NDU/Bottlenecks and IMF series kept as separate observations with their stated denominator and coverage.

findings.claim: Q1: Capital execution rate by tier (federal, provincial, local) and consolidated
findings.note: FCGO CFS three-tier tables FY2018/19 onward; WB Capital Expenditure Bottlenecks Analysis (Oct 2025).

findings.claim: Q1: Public capital expenditure as % of fiscal-year nominal GDP, all tiers
findings.note: Consolidated capex from FCGO; GDP from NSO/Agent 01 (same vintage).

findings.claim: Q2: Monthly (Nepali month) cumulative federal capital expenditure profile, share spent in final month (Ashadh) and final trimester
findings.note: FCGO monthly expenditure reports and NRB monthly CMEFS releases; Ashadh share = (12-month cumulative - 11-month cumulative)/12-month cumulative. Record NRB (cash basis) and FCGO separately.

findings.claim: Q2: Share of annual capital expenditure spent in the last fortnight of Ashadh
findings.note: Requires daily/fortnightly FCGO data or OAG/WB reporting of end-year payments; may not be publicly available.

findings.claim: Q3: Main execution failures identified in OAG annual reports (categories and frequency)
findings.note: Structured coding of OAG annual reports (52nd, 55th, 58th, 62nd and latest) chapters on project/contract audits: e.g. weak project preparation, land acquisition and clearance delays, contract variations and time extensions, mobilisation advances unsettled, year-end payments without work completion. Categories to be confirmed from text; counts pending.

findings.claim: Q3: OAG irregularities and arrears related to capital projects
findings.note: Coordinate with 11B (irregularities/arrears series); 02B extracts only the capital/project-related subset.

findings.claim: Q3: PEFA indicator scores relevant to execution (PI-1, PI-2, PI-11, PI-16, PI-21, PI-24, PI-30)
findings.note: 2024 national PEFA (data FY2019/20-FY2021/22), earlier PEFA, and Gandaki SNG PEFA 2025; scores are letter grades - record as categorical, not numeric.

findings.claim: Execution rate will be reported against both original appropriation and revised (mid-term review) estimate, because mid-year downward revision of capital budgets is a recurring practice and changes the ratio materially.
findings.note: Methodological choice; source of each denominator cited.

findings.claim: Capital expenditure follows the FCGO chart-of-accounts capital classification; capital grants to sub-national governments recorded as federal transfers are excluded from federal capex and counted at the spending tier in consolidated figures.
findings.note: Avoids double counting across tiers; must be checked against FCGO CFS consolidation notes.

data_gaps: Capital budget (original, revised) vs actual by fiscal year FY2014/15-FY2081/82 from Red Books, Economic Survey and FCGO CFS (downloads blocked).
MoF mid-term budget review documents (revised capital estimates) - not yet located as primary PDFs; only press pointer.
FCGO monthly expenditure reports by Nepali month (or NRB monthly releases) for each fiscal year - downloads blocked.
Daily/fortnightly end-of-year (Ashadh) payment data - public availability uncertain.
OAG 62nd Annual Report full text (and 63rd, if issued) - URL on oag.gov.np not pinned; English version availability unknown.
IMF PIMA report for Nepal - not located (only handbook and references in IMF 2026 Article IV).
Title/scope of World Bank document P505226 (June 2025) unverified.
FCGO CFS FY2024/25 PDF URL not pinned (index located).
Search budget exhausted in r1; remaining targeted searches (IRD/Customs/MoF mid-term review) deferred to r2.

assumptions.text: Nepali fiscal year (Shrawan-Ashadh, mid-July to mid-July); monthly profiles use Nepali months, with Ashadh as the final month.
Execution rate is reported on two denominators (original appropriation; mid-term revised estimate) and never a single unlabelled ratio.
FCGO audited consolidated statements take precedence for annual actuals; NRB cash-basis and Economic Survey partial-year figures are recorded as separate observations.
assumptions.basis_note: original label: 'assumption (source hierarchy and vintage control)'

assumptions.text: OAG findings are coded into execution-failure categories from report text; the categorisation scheme is a labelled research construct, not an OAG classification.

challenges.text: OAG irregularities and arrears series: 02B needs the capital-project subset; please record OAG chapter/table references when retrieved so both registers share one extraction.
Consolidated capex execution depends on how conditional/capital grants to provinces and local levels are recorded; please confirm grant types and their FCGO classification.

Debt simulations should treat planned capital spending as subject to execution shortfall (to be parameterised from the pending execution series), and should not assume that borrowing-financed capex converts to public capital one-for-one.
Capex execution figures circulating in press/WB summaries use differing denominators (original vs revised) and coverage (federal vs three tiers); any strategy claim should state both.

uncertainty: High: no primary document retrieved in r1; no empirical value recorded. Known methodological risks: (i) denominator choice (original vs revised budget) changes execution rates materially; (ii) federal vs three-tier coverage and treatment of intergovernmental capital grants; (iii) FCGO provisional vs audited figures and NRB cash basis differ; (iv) end-year spending may reflect payments/advances not matched by physical progress (to be tested via OAG findings); (v) PEFA scores are categorical and refer to a fixed data period; (vi) the September 2025 unrest and political transition affect FY2025/26 execution and should be treated as a break, not trend.

capex_execution_rate_series.method: Annual series FY2014/15-FY2081/82: original capital appropriation (Red Book), revised estimate (mid-term review), actual (FCGO CFS; Economic Survey cross-check); execution rate on both denominators; federal and consolidated three-tier; capex as % of FY nominal GDP. World Bank and IMF published rates recorded separately with their definitions.

execution_timing_profile.method: Cumulative capital expenditure by Nepali month for each FY from FCGO monthly reports and NRB monthly CMEFS releases; metrics: share spent in Ashadh, in final trimester (Chaitra-Ashadh), and first-half share; if available, last-fortnight share. Compare with PEFA PI-21 (in-year predictability).

audit_findings_summary.method: Structured coding of OAG annual reports (52nd, 55th, 58th, 62nd, latest) into execution-failure categories (project readiness, land/forest clearance, procurement and contract management, variations/time extensions, unsettled advances, year-end payments), each with report/chapter reference; triangulated with WB Capital Expenditure Bottlenecks Analysis, PEFA PI-11/PI-24/PI-30, PPMO annual reports and OCDS contract data. Irregularity amounts pending (shared with 11B).
